id: \rYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \rYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \rSembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rWhat is a mere peasant doing in here?
en: \rWhat is a mere peasant doing in here?
it: \rChe ci fa un semplice popolano qui dentro?

id: \rYou want the Poké Flute? I earned that by myself and you think you deserve it?
en: \rYou want the Poké Flute? I earned that by myself and you think you deserve it?
it: \rVuoi il Poké Flauto? Me lo sono guadagnato da sola e tu pensi di meritartelo?

id: \rFine... But you will have to win a battle against me first. If you lose you'll give me all your money and disappear.
en: \rFine... But you will have to win a battle against me first. If you lose you'll give me all your money and disappear.
it: \rE va bene... Ma prima dovrai battermi in una lotta. Se perdi, mi darai tutti i tuoi soldi e sparirai.
